reviewer: Codex assistant; not an independent human adjudicator
selection: Purposive disagreements plus shared visual/refusal failures; not a random sample or a full 100-question manual rescore
scope: Saved source text/cells and direct inspection of one chart and five image crops; no new parsing or model calls
limitations: Small synthetic-control calibration did not catch all corpus judge failures. Scores remain exploratory; manual observations are not a population error estimate.
recommendation: Adaptive hybrid one-pass is the best current candidate for completeness, citation support and one-call simplicity. The full agent has no demonstrated overall advantage; safe refusals and visual scoring need a better independent audit before ranking by small point differences.
